findings.finding: Cross-sectional z-score changed missing features into zero when standard deviation was unavailable. Preserve missingness; strict universe now remains invalid.
Automatic cache refresh could change frozen inputs/network. All pricing reads now validate local adjusted-price schema; refresh blocked.
Same-close execution and returns recomputed on filtered signal rows. Daily T+2 execution now required; use full price rows for forward windows.
Regime-filtered months and overlapping 3m forward returns cannot be compounded as continuous wealth. CAGR suppressed; end month inclusive.
Annual breakdown used mean*12 even for partial years. Changed to actual compounded annual sample return and exported every ledger.
CAGR after filtered missing months compresses time. Require contiguous monthly rows or leave CAGR undefined.
Retrospective flag was bypassing unknown EPS index identity. Unconditional source gate now rejects even the flag. SP500_EPS used in three entries is not Nasdaq-100 aggregate EPS.
Bankruptcy reset wealth to .001 and allowed recovery. Zero wealth now absorbs; initial buy cost charged, no missing-return zero-fill.
SEP range endpoints and wrong rotated-PDF extraction became year medians. Read rotated table layout and actual median columns; early range-only publications marked unavailable; start 2015-09-18.

First return preceded sample, first cost omitted, exit/reentry uncharged, cash used same-day DFF and trading-day annual fraction. Use first-close initial buy, costs, prior published rate/calendar accrual.
Hardcoded paths read original workspace rather than frozen copy. Paths now resolve under this copy.
Inner join removed equity sessions, so 21/63/126 rows were not actual trading-day horizons. Use full exchange calendar with backward-only signal carry and no invented post-coverage signals.

Real and random samples used different complete-horizon counts; finite Monte Carlo could output p=0; label falsely called translation circular bootstrap. Complete 3/6m real samples, add-one p, truthful method label.
Six stored legacy classifier/regressor configs are not the six current source configs. Exact superseded implementation missing.
Current-vintage PE and ETF-price/index-PE mismatch cannot establish genuine forward EPS or point-in-time availability.
Labels, features, thresholds and episodes have been repeatedly inspected; randomization assumptions and multiple exploratory studies do not make a new blind test.
Downloader is not a strategy; waterfall_autopsy.py is an unimplemented template. Safe explicit gates replace misleading success.
Compound long-short spread lacked capital/cost definition, and exhaustive basket p-value added an extra identity draw. Report arithmetic spread; exact enumeration counts each basket once.
Legacy EPS-based engines also have cost and first-sample timing inconsistencies. They are not admitted as portfolio evidence; source identity blocks execution before new historical modelling.

Future-return inner join dropped unpriceable candidates before ranking. Rank formation-day scores first; common execution dates; selected missing price raises instead of replacement. Seven-ETF counterexample and full frozen rerun.
Generic aligned labels hid 44-month benchmark versus 40-month full-universe models. Record per-row actual dates and months, preserve native ledgers, export separate shared-window comparison.

Original first five of seven acceptance checks failed. Original thresholds require at least six passes, impossible even if both unfinished placebo checks pass. Parent stopped original 500-seed job; exit 1 KeyboardInterrupt preserved, no p-values invented.
